purpose: Prospectively test whether the Nott microglia PLAC-seq contact substrate is preferentially supported by microglial regulatory chromatin relative to same-study neuronal and oligodendrocyte comparators, before E2 construction and before any protected target overlap is inspected.
preconditions_before_fit_test: Verify exact source bytes and checksums for the microglia PLAC object.
Determine what one raw interaction row represents: MAPS bin pair, cluster member, cluster representative, singleton, browser arc, or other representation.
Determine original genome build and column schema.
Count rows and unique unordered anchor pairs.
Independently harmonize to hg38 under the existing C3 liftover contract and compare against FILER's harmonized representation.
Verify same-study microglia, neuron and oligodendrocyte accessibility tracks and exact checksums.
Do not inspect AD-gene enrichment, JEPA target overlap, Morabito target-state cis correspondence, or NIH-CARD RNA-ATAC correspondence before this contract is executed.
fit_question: Does the candidate Nott microglia promoter-contact substrate preferentially align with microglial regulatory accessibility relative to neuron and oligodendrocyte regulatory accessibility, after controlling genomic opportunity and contact geometry?
unit: promoter-distal contact pair; donor is not available as an interaction-level independent unit in the public processed contact object, so no pseudo-donor replication claim is permitted.

primary_comparison.positive_context: microglia PLAC contacts evaluated against microglia accessibility
negative_contexts: same microglia PLAC contacts evaluated against neuron accessibility
same microglia PLAC contacts evaluated against oligodendrocyte accessibility
primary_comparison.same_study_reason: Comparator cell types originate from the same Nott study and PLAC/ATAC lineage, reducing study-level processing differences relative to cross-study controls.

nuisance_controls: mappability or callable support if available from the source artifact
primary_statistic: For each microglia PLAC promoter-distal pair, measure whether the distal anchor overlaps/accesses the cell-type accessibility layer. Compare microglia support against same-pair neuron and oligodendrocyte support under a paired, geometry-preserving null/contrast. The exact overlap tolerance must be source-coordinate exact or predeclared before execution; no target-gene-dependent tolerance is allowed.
paired_structure: The same contact pairs are evaluated against all three cell-type accessibility layers. Cell-type contrasts are therefore paired at the contact-pair level.

null.primary: promoter-fixed distal shuffle preserving chromosome and the promoter's empirical distance distribution, with contact-degree structure preserved where feasible
forbidden: choosing a null to maximize microglia significance
using target genes or disease loci to define null eligibility

pass_fail.primary_requirement: Microglia support must exceed BOTH neuron and oligodendrocyte support under the frozen paired contrast, and observed microglia support must exceed the promoter-fixed shuffled null.
effect_reporting: confidence interval or bootstrap interval under the declared resampling unit
pass_fail.hard_stop: If either neuron or oligodendrocyte materially equals or exceeds microglia after nuisance control, classify NOT_MICROGLIA_FIT_FOR_TARGET_CONSTRUCTION. Do not rescue by restricting to AD loci, target genes, or post-hoc contact subsets.

attrition_reporting: rows removed for malformed or non-cis records if relevant
pairs with callable accessibility support in each cell type

interpretation.pass_supports: The Nott contact substrate is preferentially compatible with microglial regulatory chromatin within this same-study comparator system and is suitable to proceed to E2 construction qualification.
pass_does_not_support: universal microglia specificity across ages or cohorts
interpretation.fail_supports: The candidate contact substrate is not sufficiently microglia-fit for load-bearing target construction under the frozen comparator system.
interpretation.fail_does_not_prove: absence of microglial biology in Nott or in the project.

forbidden_before_result: AD-risk enrichment used as a tuning objective
